representativeSamples.label: typical
representativeSamples.selectionRule: draw minimising ((margin−p50 margin)/sd margin)² + ((total−p50 total)/sd total)²; ties → lowest runIndex

representativeSamples.label: close
representativeSamples.selectionRule: among draws with the smallest |final margin| (1), the one whose total is nearest p50 total; ties → lowest runIndex

representativeSamples.label: high
representativeSamples.selectionRule: draw whose total is nearest the 95th-percentile total (255), then margin nearest p50 margin; ties → lowest runIndex

representativeSamples.label: low
representativeSamples.selectionRule: draw whose total is nearest the 5th-percentile total (197), then margin nearest p50 margin; ties → lowest runIndex

representativeSamples.label: upset
representativeSamples.selectionRule: the sim underdog (away, pHome 0.8266) wins in 1734 draws; among them, the draw nearest their median (margin, total) in sd units; ties → lowest runIndex
